item: Bulk summary & translation queue and Insights backlog drain run on the server (R600 PR 2)
key_paths: src/jobs/llm_bulk_queue.py src/jobs/insights_backlog.py src/api/llm.py src/api/jobs.py src/static/app-analysis.js src/static/app-diagnostics.js tests/test_llm_bulk_queue.py
summary: The queue of bulk summarize/translate runs and the Insights never-attempted backlog drain left the browser tab for two writer BackgroundJobs (llm-bulk-queue, insights-backlog), so closing the browser loses nothing. The queue is stored in the encrypted app_state store, comes back paused after a restart (nothing starts by itself), resumes without storing an article twice (resume_since), and forgets a run's search once it ends; the drain stops on a stuck backlog and stands aside for restores, the storage guard and rival writers. Local only: the model clients are loopback-only, pinned by a test.
